_note: Part 1 journal entries (Mani's notes). Text Mani would write; Tanglish carries an English subtitle. Episode 1 entries approved 2026-10-21; items marked design are not in the screenplay and may change.

e1_goal_packing.title: Pack, then go
e1_goal_packing.text: Pack the sweets, the diyas and the radio for Nila. Then drive to Greyhaven.

e1_goal_leave.title: Get on the road
e1_goal_leave.text: Take the bag and the car keys. The car is out back. Greyhaven by tonight.

e1_goal_ruth.title: Find Nila
e1_goal_ruth.text: Get to Greyhaven. Talk only to Ruth.

e1_voicemail.title: Nila's voicemail (Sunday 23:52)
e1_voicemail.text: Station-ku call pannadha. Naan oru vishayam kandupidichiruken. Ruth kitta mattum pesu. Yaara venaalum nambu, aana andha--
e1_voicemail.subtitle: Don't call the station. I found something. Talk only to Ruth. Trust anyone, but don't trust the-- (It cuts off there.)

e1_person_ruth.title: Ruth
e1_person_ruth.text: Nila says talk only to her. Haven't met her.

e1_person_nila.title: Nila
e1_person_nila.text: My sister, 25. Criminology degree, chose radio: night host of After Hours on Lake Merrow 94.1 FM. Hasn't picked up since Sunday.

e1_whiteboard.title: My whiteboard
e1_whiteboard.text: Data Analytics Engineer: 2nd round, Thursday. Work so far: Auragle, Software Developer to Team Lead, 2018-2024. Before that, Sri Valli Leathers (Appa's shop), Store Manager, 2013-2017.

e1_gift_radio.title: The gift radio
e1_gift_radio.text: New handheld ham radio for Nila. Her old one is held together with tape.

e1_grad_photo.title: Convocation photo
e1_grad_photo.text: Master's in business data analytics, University of Windsor. Finished in August.

e1_grad_photo_back.title: Back of the convocation photo
e1_grad_photo_back.text: Nila's handwriting: "Anna, proud of you. Now go get a real job!"

e1_nila_photo.title: Nila's first night on air
e1_nila_photo.text: Headphones crooked, grinning. Appa didn't speak to her for a week after she chose radio. Then he listened to every show.

e1_baby_photo.title: Baby Nila
e1_baby_photo.text: Old print of Nila as a baby, pinned on my board.

e1_baby_photo_date.title: Nila's birth year
e1_baby_photo_date.text: The camera's date stamp on her baby photo: 14 08 2001. Nila was born in 2001.

e1_note_interview.title: Sticky note
e1_note_interview.text: Thursday, 2nd round. Revise SQL window functions. Don't say "synergy".

e1_note_diwali.title: Sticky note
e1_note_diwali.text: Diwali Sunday: light the diyas with Nila. Promised Amma.
